data.action: 手持折扇侧身回眸，夜空烟花璀璨，浴衣下摆微扬，神情柔和含蓄
data.camera: medium shot, low angle looking up, dramatic sky view
data.description: 【星见雅 · 夏夜花火与深蓝浴衣】临海神社石阶的高台上，夜空绽放出一朵璀璨耀眼的千轮金色花火。雅身穿月夜深蓝暗纹浴衣，系着深红腰带，手持一柄精巧的折扇侧身回眸。盛大花火的光华映照在她清秀绝俗的面庞上，金色的狐瞳中罕见地流露出一丝少女特有的柔软微光。
data.lighting: 漫天花火爆开的金色、绯红多重光晕映照脸庞与发丝
data.location: 神社鸟居石阶高台观景处
data.promptProse: Standing on the hillside shrine stone steps beneath brilliant cascading golden fireworks, Miyabi turns over one shoulder while holding a delicate folding fan in her elegant midnight navy floral yukata tied with a deep crimson obi. Vivid festival light illuminates her amber eyes, fox ears and plush white tail against the star-filled evening sky. Medium low-angle portrait, detailed torii background, cinematic lighting.
data.title: 星见雅 · 夏夜花火与深蓝浴衣
